infobox.usage: Unlocks the cash registers of the OLI store on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: OLI cash register key (OLI reg.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the OLI store outlet cash registers at the ULTRA shopping mall.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 1 needs to be obtained for the quest Supervisor

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Interchange
sections.text: - On a table in an office in the back of the OLI store

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Cash registers in the front of the OLI store on Interchange.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: - The content of 18x Cash register TAR2-2
